shortDescription: Set or delete key value pairs from an etcd3 cluster

options.name: ca_cert
options.description: The Certificate Authority to use to verify the etcd host. Required if O(client_cert) and O(client_key) are defined.

options.name: client_cert
options.description: PEM formatted certificate chain file to be used for SSL client authentication. Required if O(client_key) is defined.

options.name: client_key
options.description: PEM formatted file that contains your private key to be used for SSL client authentication. Required if O(client_cert) is defined.

options.name: host
options.description: The IP address of the cluster.

options.name: key
options.description: The key where the information is stored in the cluster.

options.name: password
options.description: The password to use for authentication. Required if O(user) is defined.

options.name: port
options.description: The port number used to connect to the cluster.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the value for the key. Can be present or absent.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The socket level timeout in seconds.

options.name: user
options.description: The etcd user to authenticate with.
